# Entify

Entify is an open-source entity resolution and record linkage workspace for deduplicating messy datasets and reviewing explainable match clusters.

## Summary

Entify helps users upload tabular data, profile and clean records, configure blocking rules, define field comparison logic, run Splink-powered entity resolution, and inspect duplicate-record clusters. It combines a Next.js frontend, a FastAPI backend, DuckDB, Supabase, Clerk authentication, and Splink.

## Primary Use Cases

- Entity resolution
- Record linkage
- Data deduplication
- Customer 360 matching
- Master data management preparation
- Data quality investigation
- Identity resolution
- Fuzzy matching workflow design
- Explainable duplicate detection

## Architecture

- Frontend: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, DuckDB-WASM, Supabase, Clerk
- Backend: FastAPI, Splink 4, DuckDB, pandas, sentence-transformers
- Persistence: Supabase schema in `frontend/supabase_schema.sql`

## Important Files

- `README.md`: Main project overview, setup, roadmap, and SEO summary.
- `frontend/README.md`: Frontend architecture and contributor guide.
- `backend/README.md`: Backend API, runtime, and testing guide.
- `frontend/app/projects/[id]/page.tsx`: Main entity resolution workspace route.
- `frontend/lib/projects/workspaceExecution.ts`: DuckDB loading and backend resolution orchestration.
- `backend/api.py`: FastAPI route definitions.
- `backend/services/splink_service.py`: Splink entity resolution service layer.
- `backend/services/semantic_blocking_service.py`: Semantic blocking suggestion service.

## Public Description

Entify is an open-source entity resolution application for finding duplicate and linked records in messy datasets. It provides a guided UI for profiling data, building blocking rules, configuring fuzzy comparisons, running Splink matching jobs, and reviewing explainable clusters.
